claim_statement: O*NET's Human Resources Specialists occupation (13-1071.00) lists HR Generalist among its sample of reported job titles, alongside coordinator, specialist, analyst, and recruiter titles.
issue: Core assertion (HR Generalist as a reported title) is quoted verbatim, but the statement's enumeration adds 'specialist' titles not present in the excerpt; quote the full sample-titles list or drop 'specialist' from the sentence.

claim_statement: The O*NET occupational definition frames this work around recruiting, screening, interviewing, and placing individuals within an organization.
issue: Quote is the occupation-level description of 13-1071.00 (the parent occupation that also covers recruiter/coordinator titles), so 'frames this work' risks framing HR Generalist as a recruiting-first role; label the parent occupation explicitly and note the definition is occupation-wide, not generalist-specific.

claim_statement: The occupation includes maintaining employment records for hiring, termination, leave, transfer, or promotion events using HR management system software.
issue: Quote stops at 'related to events' — the event types (hiring, termination, leave, transfer, promotion) and 'HR management system software' are asserted but absent from the evidence; extend the quote to the full O*NET task sentence or trim the statement to the quoted fragment.

claim_statement: HR manager work is defined as acting as a link between management and employees by handling questions and resolving work-related problems.
issue: Quote covers only the first half ('link between management and employees by handling questions'); 'resolving work-related problems' is unevidenced, and 'is defined as' elevates one 11-3121.00 task into the occupation definition. Extend the quote and reword as one task among many, flagged as manager-level (adjacent occupation 11-3121.00, not the generalist's 13-1071.00).

claim_statement: HR managers coordinate staff work spanning employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations functions.
issue: Quote is a subject-less, verb-less modifier fragment ('relating to employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations'); no part of the asserted action (coordinate staff work) appears in the evidence, so the claim is unsupported as recorded. Re-source the complete sentence if a manager-level foundation is needed.

claim_statement: BLS tracks compensation, benefits, and job analysis as a distinct specialist occupational area adjacent to generalist HR work.
issue: Evidence is only an occupation title; 'distinct specialist occupational area' is inferable from a separate listing, but 'adjacent to generalist HR work' and the 'BLS tracks' attribution are editorial gloss not present in the excerpt — verify source attribution and trim the gloss.

claim_statement: Employee relations casework: handling employee inquiries, complaints, and investigations — recorded in 3 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 1 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Statement scope adds 'investigations', which the exemplar quote does not show and the detail attributes to coordinator and business-partner postings, so the 3/12 count mixes HR titles under an 'HR Generalist postings' label. Counts are sample-scoped with no trend overreach, and the growth-variant check is N/A (no product-growth/growth-marketing/sales-AE content exists in this draft) — the real defect is HR-variant conflation; split by title or relabel the sample as the generalist family.

claim_statement: HRIS administration: Workday configuration and HRIS record maintenance — recorded in 3 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 2 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: 'Workday configuration' appears only in the detail; the exemplar quote evidences generic HRIS maintenance. If the 3/12 count was not adjudicated on Workday specifically, narrow the label to HRIS administration or recount only Workday-mentioning postings.

claim_statement: Employee lifecycle administration: onboarding, transfers, promotions, and exit processing — recorded in 3 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 1 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Quote evidences onboarding only; transfers, promotions, exit processing, and verifications rest on the detail summary. The count is also 3/12 from a single employer (1/5): verify each lifecycle element per posting and disclose the single-employer concentration.

claim_statement: HR policy and employment law compliance: employment legislation and HR policy guidance — recorded in 3 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 2 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Exemplar quote is generic HR-policy language with no employment-law/legislation content; 'compliance' and 'employment law' are supported only by the detail. Extend the quote or narrow the label; the exemplar shares source src_7938a9d04e30b7356116 with clm_32fd, so verify the two counts use distinct match criteria.

claim_statement: Strategic HR business partnering: coaching and influencing senior leaders — recorded in 3 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 2 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Detail states the matches are senior business-partner postings (coaching Director/VP+ leaders); presenting this as HR Generalist demand conflates Generalist with HR Business Partner unless the sample is explicitly family-scoped. Keep only with a variant split or family relabel.

claim_statement: Workforce analytics and org design: workforce analytics and organizational optimization — recorded in 3 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 2 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: 'Workforce analytics' and org design read as senior BP/COE requirements, and the 3/12 count likely shares postings with clm_be5c/clm_4387 (same senior cohort), so counts are not independent; disclose overlap and split variant.

claim_statement: People programs and retention: ownership of people programs, engagement, and retention — recorded in 2 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 2 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Detail says the evidence comes from a business-partner posting and the label's engagement/retention elements sit outside the exemplar quote; n=2/12 across 2 employers is thin — keep only as a family-level signal and consider merging with the senior-BP cluster.

claim_statement: HR advisory enablement: peer coaching and QA feedback for consultants — recorded in 1 of 12 admitted HR Generalist postings (no variant split for this role) from 1 of 5 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: A single posting from a single employer (1/12, 1/5) is presented as a demand signal; the detail describes an HR consulting-services role coaching HR consultants (not in-house generalist work), and the exemplar quote ('providing quality assurance feedback') does not evidence the consultant/peer-mentoring context — a one-posting anecdote cannot carry a signal category.

claim_statement: Market research analyst work includes search marketing tactics, web metrics analysis, and recommendations that raise search engine ranking and visibility for target markets.
issue: Modal strengthening: the source task says 'May employ search marketing tactics' (permissive/optional task bullet), while the statement converts it into 'work includes' (definite constituent duty); the hedge is dropped without basis, changing an optional activity into a definitional one.

claim_statement: Marketing manager duties include overseeing product development and monitoring trends that signal demand for new products and services.
issue: Disjunction turned into conjunction: the source lists 'Oversee product development OR monitor trends' (alternative duties), but the statement asserts duties include both overseeing product development and monitoring trends, asserting both branches where the source offers either.

claim_statement: programmatic advertising sales: programmatic revenue target ownership — recorded in 2 of 26 admitted Growth Manager postings (variant scope sales-account-executive) from 2 of 8 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Prevalence claim not auditable from cited evidence: the statement asserts 2 of 26 postings from 2 of 8 employers, but the attached evidence identifies only Duolingo (both the quote and the detail); the second matched employer/posting is unnamed and unquoted, so employers_matched=2 cannot be verified. Name and quote the second employer or reduce the count to 1 employer.

claim_statement: retail media consultative selling: consultative solution-selling into retail media accounts — recorded in 3 of 26 admitted Growth Manager postings (variant scope sales-account-executive) from 1 of 8 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Quote does not support the retail-media qualifier: the quote evidences only a consultative, education-led sales approach; 'retail media' comes solely from Instacart context in the detail, not the quote. Additionally all 3 matched postings are from 1 employer, so the domain-specific framing rests on a single employer's ads ecosystem and exceeds the quoted evidence.

claim_statement: public sector procurement sales: SLED and federal procurement sales motion — recorded in 4 of 26 admitted Growth Manager postings (variant scope sales-account-executive) from 2 of 8 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Quote covers SLED only ('capture SLED sales opportunities', Vanta); the federal half of the headline rests on unquoted detail (Figma federal civilian). Presenting SLED and federal as one procurement sales motion overstates what the cited quote shows.

claim_statement: lifecycle and retention marketing: lifecycle journey ownership with segmentation and testing — recorded in 1 of 26 admitted Growth Manager postings (variant scope growth-marketing) from 1 of 8 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Unsupported term in headline: 'retention' has no support anywhere in the evidence — the quote covers lifecycle journeys and campaigns only, and the detail adds segmentation, A/B testing and SQL, not retention or retention metrics; the signal is 1 of 26 postings from 1 employer. Strike 'retention' or attach a retention-specific quote.

claim_statement: expansion and renewal revenue: expansion and renewal of existing accounts — recorded in 4 of 26 admitted Growth Manager postings (variant scope sales-account-executive) from 2 of 8 employers in the 2026-09-30 US sample.
issue: Quote supports expansion only ('maintaining and growing a targeted book' of existing customers); 'renewal' appears only in the detail's paraphrase (upsell and renewals) with no quoted support, so the renewal half of the headline is not directly evidenced by the cited quote.
